scope: Seven-layer gamma-to-deformation inference ladder and canonical failure modes audit

layers.name: Detector Response & Doppler Reconstruction
layers.input_observable: Lab-frame Ge pulse heights and Doppler-shifted gamma lineshapes
layers.output_quantity: Deconvolved decay time profile and Doppler velocity profile
layers.case_study: 133Pr non-monotonic feeding jump (1100 ps -> 1.9 ps -> 14 ps, 78.6x)
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Slowing-down parameterization and feeding cascade delay mimicking apparent nuclear elongation

layers.name: Coincidence Gating & Level Placement
layers.input_observable: Prompt gamma-gamma coincidence matrices and time-gated intensities
layers.output_quantity: Level scheme topology and total feeding/decay intensity balances
layers.case_study: 135Nd chiral doublet partner bands (Mukhopadhyay 2007 Table I)
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Unresolved sidefeeding or missing interband branches distorting parent branching ratios

layers.name: Angular Distribution & Multipolarity Assignment
layers.input_observable: Directional angular distribution W(theta) and Compton linear polarization P
layers.output_quantity: Spin-parity J^pi and multipole mixing ratio delta(E2/M1)
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Assuming pure E2 when delta is unmeasured, artificially inflating extracted quadrupole strength

layers.name: Lifetime Deconvolution & Partial Transition Rates
layers.input_observable: Mean level lifetime tau, branching ratio p_gamma, conversion coefficient alpha
layers.output_quantity: Partial radiative transition rate lambda(E2) and reduced probability B(E2)
layers.case_study: Standard SI conversion T_gamma(E2) = 12.2519 E^5 B(E2) ps^-1
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Using inconsistent rate-unit conventions or conflating total level lifetime with in-band B(E2)

layers.name: Rotor Geometry & K-Projection Conversion
layers.input_observable: Reduced transition probability B(E2; I -> I-2)
layers.case_study: 131Ce Li 2004 (K=11/2) vs Singh 2016 (K=1/2) Clebsch-Gordan ratio sqrt(169/114) = 1.2176 reconciliation
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Mismatching K-projection quantum numbers (CG ratio sqrt(169/114) = 1.2176 producing 22% apparent step)

layers.name: Mean-Field Parameterization & Triaxial Coupling
layers.input_observable: Transition quadrupole moment Qt and intrinsic moment Q20
layers.output_quantity: Quadrupole deformation beta2 and asymmetry parameter gamma
layers.case_study: Singh 2016 Eq.(5) Qt = Q20 * cos(gamma + 30) / cos(30)
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Assuming axial prolate symmetry, which underestimates true beta2 by 32.5% at gamma=20 deg and 67.4% at gamma=30 deg

layers.name: Collective Mode Discrimination & Multi-Band Companions
layers.input_observable: Multi-band excitation spectra, partner-band splittings, and crossing profiles
layers.output_quantity: Structural interpretation (chiral vibration, wobbling, shears, or shape coexistence)
layers.case_study: 136Nd Band 2 11x B(E2) drop and 136Sm 10.4% Qt step across crossings
layers.canonical_failure_mode: Misattributing quasiparticle alignment and wave-function mixing to whole-nucleus geometry collapse

checks.name: Ladder contains exactly 7 sequential inference layers
Layer 1 correctly identifies Doppler response and 133Pr feeding jump
Layer 2 correctly identifies level scheme gating and 135Nd branching compensation
Layer 3 correctly identifies multipolarity mixing and wobbling controversy
Layer 4 correctly identifies partial rate conversion contract
Layer 5 correctly identifies K-projection Clebsch-Gordan reconciliation
Layer 6 correctly identifies Singh Eq.(5) triaxial underestimation
Layer 7 correctly identifies band-crossing mixing vs core shape collapse

conclusion: Nuclear quadrupole deformation beta2 is an inferential construct at Layer 6; scientific validity requires satisfying the consistency contracts and controlling the failure modes of all 5 preceding layers.
